arguments.name: provinceCode
arguments.description:
Province code to search by exact match (e.g., "000005").
If provided, it takes priority over provinceName.

raw.name: provinceCode
raw.description:
Province code to search by exact match (e.g., "000005").
If provided, it takes priority over provinceName.

arguments.name: provinceName
arguments.description:
Province name to search by partial match, case-insensitive (e.g., "magui" matches "Maguindanao").
Returns the first match for editing, and includes all matches in the response for visibility.

raw.name: provinceName
raw.description:
Province name to search by partial match, case-insensitive (e.g., "magui" matches "Maguindanao").
Returns the first match for editing, and includes all matches in the response for visibility.

arguments.name: newProvinceName
arguments.description:
New province name to set.
If not provided (or empty), the existing name remains unchanged.

raw.name: newProvinceName
raw.description:
New province name to set.
If not provided (or empty), the existing name remains unchanged.

arguments.name: country
arguments.description:
Country to assign to the Province. Accepts either: a 6-digit country code (e.g., "000175"), or an exact country name as shown in the dropdown (case-insensitive match).
If not provided (or empty), the existing country remains unchanged.

raw.name: country
